routes.name: Chopped on the Guidebook
routes.desc: Left hand side of the cave, overhanging line on super jugs. Crosses over the anchor of 'Baba Max' and finishes on the anchor with 'Smoked Out'. 12 slings.

routes.name: Baba Max
routes.desc: Green threads up the left side of the cave. Climbs out onto the free hanging stalactite. 7 slings.

routes.name: Dude Abides
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Smoked Out' and Round the Outside, then to the left up the slab to the green anchor in the cave. 3 titanium bolts, 3 slings.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Rope to start route core exposed

routes.name: Smoked Out
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Dude Abides', then right and straight up. Go all the way to the right to climb 'Round the Outside'. 5 titanium bolts, 3 slings, 1 fixed extended clip.

routes.name: Round the Outside
routes.desc: Shares the first half with 'Smoked Out' and Dude Abides, then traverses to the anchor of 'Chong Phli Posse'. 1 titanium bolt, 5 slings.

routes.name: Chong Phli Posse
routes.desc: Shares the anchor with 'Round the Outside'. Gives access to the following three upper pitches. 1 titanium bolt, 3 slings. 1st pitch of Fin de Chalam, Flying Snake and Stone Rider.

routes.name: Fin de Chalam
routes.desc: The left-most extension of 'Chong Phli Posse'. 31m from the ground. 3 titanium bolts, 7 slings. Share start with Flying Snake and Stone Rider.

routes.name: Flying Snake
routes.desc: The middle extension of either 'Round the Outside' or 'Chong Phli Posse'. Shares the start with 'Stone Rider' and Fin de Chalam, then straight up. 29m to the ground. 6 slings.

routes.name: Stone Rider
routes.desc: The right-most extension of either 'Round the Outside' or 'Chong Phli Posse'. Shares the start with 'Flying Snake' and Fin de Chalam, then veers right. 31m to the ground. 3 titanium bolts, 4 slings.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Anchor carabiner opens very hard

routes.name: Eminem
routes.desc: His palms are sweaty, knees weak, arms are heavy...

routes.name: Shady
routes.desc: Short with a steep start. 5 titanium bolts.

routes.name: Slim / Slim Shady
routes.desc: Right of 'Shady', purple slings and titanium bolts. 3D climbing through the bottom overhang onto the big fin. 2 titanium bolts, 6 slings.

routes.name: Yellow Moon / Tim's Big Smile
routes.desc: Starts just right of 'Slim', through the roof on the right side of the feature and up into the stem corner. 9 blue slings.

routes.name: Make it Funky
routes.desc: Right of 'Yellow Moon', 4m left of 'Music Wall'. Climbs through a steep bulge to a green anchor. 3 bolts, 6 slings.

routes.name: A Pinch Tu-far
routes.desc: Steep face, with thin tufa, short and spicy 🔥
